newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Time falls on delay worries of unit.
newsitem.headline: Time falls on delay worries of unit.

text.p: The stock of Time Engineering Bhd fell on worries over a probable delay to the listing of its telecommunications unit, analysts and dealers said.
Around 0730 GMT, the stock was down 8.0 cents to 4.08 ringgit, after earlier falling to a 12-month low of 3.80. Volume was heavy at 1.15 million shares.
"They say they may delay the listing of Time Telecom...they will have no cash," said Phua Lee Kerk, head of research at Jupiter Securities.
Time said on Tuesday it may consider delaying the listing of its Time Telecomunications Holdings Bhd unit due to soft market conditions.
Any postponement would delay the injection of new funds needed to expand the company's telecommunications infrastructure.
"If you delay the listing, you are deferring your subscriber expansion," added Pesaka Jardine Fleming analyst Shamsul Shamsuddin.

To entice investors to buy the stock, the flotation of the 470 million new shares at 1.25 ringgit, was to be linked to an attractive telecommunications package which would boost its telecomunications subscriber base.
